lens: Skeptic, geometry first. I re-ran the w44a scripts (m.py, q17.py, d.py, w.py) unchanged with r44 -> r45 and s44 -> s45, so the numbers are comparable; all r44 numbers reproduce w44a. I added t2.py, which samples strap hue in small boxes on the actual straps, because my earlier whole-region teal mask was biased by the photo's blue fabric. Photos are y_47300 / y_47301 / y_47303 at 930x575 LANCZOS. Crops are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/bd010ea5-6deb-54d2-81da-591cf8fca07a/scratchpad/raterA45: cmp_q15/q16/q17 (r44 / r45 / photo), z17.png (q17 near seats, render | photo), z17head.png (q17 heads, r44 | r45 | photo), ph_strap.png / r45_strap.png, and c_e4_head / c_e3_side / c_e11_panedge / c_e2_back (s44 | s45).
calibrationNote: Up 0.05 from 8.35. The detail mean is 8.28 (w44 8.28). Net gains: the head-on cover width is back on y_47300 (73-74 px vs 71-72, was 77-78); belt presence rose about 50 % in q17 and 15 % in q16, and an alternate strap end now hangs over the pan lip; the centre pillow can be reviewed in the studio. Losses: the tongue-strap hue went from under-green (G/R 1.52) to over-cyan (G/R 2.35, against 1.81 in the photo), and the shallower wings did not reveal the cover in q17 (no row gained). Still not 8.5. q17 heads read as a thin strip beside a big wing where y_47303 shows a broad grey flap (partly a camera-angle question, w44b-1), the straps are at 43 % of the photo's pixels, and the drape is a stiff tab. Back, shell, screen, tray, legs and far LOD are unchanged.

priorIssues.note: Head-on width fixed: the q15 rows give D 74, E 73, F 73-80 and G 74-80 px, against 71-72 in y_47300 (w44 77-78). Cover E is L67 against 65 (inside 5 L). The wing silhouette in q15 is unchanged (the vertical run for D/E is 245-300 / 244-300, as in w44; G is 255-294). q17 is not fixed: rows at x 660-800, y 110-160 are 58 52 43 41 37 40, against w44's 57 52 44 46 37 47 and the photo's 60 53 61 63 77 56, so only 1 of 6 rows is >= 55 (target 5). The q17 band is L129, B/R 1.42, and the wing is L71, B/R 2.17, both unchanged. In e4_head the wing front is visibly set back, but at the q17 view (about 20-25 degrees more edge-on than y_47303, per w44b-1) the wing's side face still occludes the cover.
The q15 seat C box is L100 against 66, as expected under the default.

q17 teal px 1629 (target >= 1800, photo 3785) and q16 2633 (target >= 2800, photo 3771). Strap px in the near q17 region y >= 440, x 500-600 went 212 -> 253. The lip drape exists on alternate seats (e11, and the q16 near seat), but I see no bright latch on the near q17 pans: the near seat's latch is hidden behind the armrest pad at this angle. New problem: the hue overshoots (w45a-2).
q15 light px D-G 192 / 50 / 51 / 52 against 96 / 40 / 0 / 15. Cover F L56 against 44. Back F L90 against 70. Pillow E p90/p10 1.33 against 1.92. All unchanged.
e4c_pillow4 shows the 4-seat centre block with its piped navy pillows at close range.
q16 covers L74 / 67 / 52 against 64 / 83 / 100. q17 grazing cover-like px are L191, B/R 1.17, against 162 / 1.37.

issues.title: Carried w44a-1: the q17 headrest cover is still a thin strip beside the wing; the shallower wing front did not help
issues.evidence: q17 rows y 110-160 are 58 52 43 41 37 40 against the photo's 60 53 61 63 77 56; w44 was 57 52 44 46 37 47. z17head.png: y_47303 shows a broad grey flap about 120 x 95 px hanging over each pad front with a narrow roll beside it. The render shows a 10-15 px pale strip and a big dotted wing face. The head-on width is now right, so the cover must not get wider.
issues.fix: First have the integrator check the q17 camera against y_47303. The photo is higher and more frontal, and if the camera is about 20 degrees off, geometry alone will not close this. If the camera is right, in 09a_econ.js cut the aisle-side wing's side face: reduce its lateral bulge or its forward depth by 1.5-2 cm at the outer edge rather than at the front, and let the cover's forward foot drop 2 cm lower over the pad so it reads as a flap from the side. Keep the width at 0.22 m.
issues.check: q17 rows y 110-160 >= 55 in at least 4 of 6; q15 head-on run stays 70-75 px.

issues.title: The tongue-strap teal now overshoots into cyan and is too dark
issues.evidence: t2.py, on strap pixels only: render q17 #2e6da0, G/R 2.35, B/G 1.47, L96 (w44 #426597, G/R 1.52). y_47303 near straps #4177b9 and #4278b7, G/R 1.81, B/G 1.52-1.55, L111-112, with a lit top fifth of #5894d8 / #6dade5.
